verdict.rationale: Composio's core architecture is exactly meta-tools: a fixed small set (7 meta-tools) that discover, authorize, and execute tools on demand rather than dumping thousands of tool definitions into context, documented in detail with sessions, toolkit-scoping, and MCP delivery, and corroborated by a live probe confirming the hosted meta-tool/MCP endpoint is real. Missing for 10: independent third-party benchmarking of context-size savings or hands-on agent trace showing runtime tool search in action.
